pruning_safety.initial_runner:
import json,os,re,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/tmp/drvgo-sdk-prune-safety');out.mkdir();go='/nix/store/xrgn6m0c5vbz06467q06zdwnk6qqdl7z-go-1.26.5/bin/go';root=Path('/nix/store/piiq71wpxfz8b0l2kvpfnl00412yaa48-go-libnix-planning-toolchain/share/go/src')
env=os.environ|{'GOTOOLCHAIN':'local','GOENV':'off','GOPROXY':'off','GOMAXPROCS':'4'}
module=out/'project';module.mkdir();(module/'go.mod').write_text('module example.com/prune-probe\ngo 1.25\n');(module/'main.go').write_text('package main\nfunc main() {}\n')
records=[]
for label,data in [('package-mismatch','package different\n'),('invalid-import','package main\nimport nope\n'),('valid-test','package main\nimport "testing"\nfunc TestX(t *testing.T) {}\n'),('removed',None)]:
 f=module/'main_test.go'
 if data is None:f.unlink()
 else:f.write_text(data)
 p=subprocess.run([go,'list','-deps','.'],cwd=module,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True);records.append(dict(case=label,returncode=p.returncode,stderr=p.stderr,stdout=p.stdout))
 print(label,p.returncode,p.stderr.strip(),flush=True)
paths=[]
for d in sorted((root/'cmd').rglob('*')):
 if not d.is_dir() or any(x in ['internal','vendor'] for x in d.relative_to(root/'cmd').parts):continue
 files=[f for f in d.glob('*.go') if not f.name.endswith('_test.go')]
 if files:paths.append(str(d.relative_to(root)))
p=subprocess.run([go,'list','-e','-find','-json=ImportPath,Name,Error',*paths],cwd=module,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True);(out/'public-cmd-packages.log').write_text(p.stderr);(out/'public-cmd-packages.json').write_text(p.stdout)
items=[];decoder=json.JSONDecoder();text=p.stdout
while text.strip():
 item,end=decoder.raw_decode(text.lstrip());items.append(item);text=text.lstrip()[end:]
libraries=[i for i in items if i.get('Name') not in [None,'main'] and 'Error' not in i]
print('valid public cmd libraries',len(libraries),[i['ImportPath'] for i in libraries],flush=True)
report=dict(test_file_validation=records,public_cmd_packages=items,public_cmd_libraries=libraries)
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
